content.short: Celer Network is a blockchain interoperability protocol for cross-chain messaging and liquidity.
content.description: Celer Network is a blockchain interoperability protocol that enables a seamless cross-chain experience for tokens, DeFi, GameFi, NFTs, governance, and more across multiple networks. Dapps enabled by Celer provide users with efficient liquidity access, coherent application logic, and shared state across chains, all delivered through a single-transaction user experience. This design supports cross-chain interactions while preserving consistent behavior and liquidity across different networks.
